name: groove-flamenco
brief: Fourteen seconds of the disco routine from the groove clip, danced by one person alone in the middle of the ninja's stage, the window behind her: a wide low stance, a sway and a side-step out and back, a quarter-turn, then the disco point, up over the head and down, again and again, and a held point to finish, square on to the house. Made for a short film with a camera that pushes in low (`just omni-film groove-flamenco`). Needs the clip's motion first (`just video groove`). The clip is a private test: never publish it, and no sound.

beats.action: the routine's last stretch, ending on a held disco point facing the house
beats.driven_by: video: groove, shot 2, seconds 68.47 to 82.47, at centre, the last frame square on

push_in.about: Low and wide to a low medium shot: the lens starts 38 cm off the floor, 5.6 m out, the whole stage in view, and pushes in slowly, easing in and out, to 2.9 m out and 50 cm up, knees to raised hand, tilting up from 6 to 16 degrees so she reads tall.
